summary: Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (4 roles), RBAC (warehouse/driver 403 on finance, cashier 403 on product create), products+HPP auto-calc, stock adjust, low-stock, customers CRUD + deposit topup, POS cash sale w/ stock movement (filled- / empty+ on exchange), B2B credit control (tempo over limit blocked 400, deposit over balance blocked 400), tempo within limit -> outstanding + receivable increment + settle, driver recon w/ shortage->driver_debts, payroll formula base+units*rate-deductions, finance summary and asset balance. Frontend: login screen loads with all 4 demo chips, owner login navigates to (tabs) dashboard showing Neraca Aset Wadah KPIs (Isi/Kosong/Kurir/Dipinjam) + Stok Menipis + Transaksi Terbaru. POS Kasir screen works: category chips (Semua/Gas LPG/Air Galon/Isi Ulang) filter, plus/minus steppers change qty and update cart total, tukar tabung toggle appears when qty>0, payment method chips present (Tunai/Transfer/QRIS/Tempo/Deposit), checkout produces 'Transaksi berhasil!' toast and resets cart. Role-based tab visibility fully correct: owner=5, cashier=Beranda/Kasir/Pelanggan, warehouse=Beranda/Stok, driver=Beranda/Driver. Stok/Pelanggan/Driver screens render add-buttons, adjust modals, and recon form with expected_deposit and difference calculations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~776 lines - approaching threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, products, transactions, recon, finance) as feature-set grows.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers, but functional today.
check_b2b_credit tempo overdue check uses due_date < now-7d; correct for enforcement, but code review confirmed the logic matches PRD.
seed_data_creation: Tests create a couple of TEST_ prefixed products/customers via API (TEST_LPG5, TEST_Cust1) which persist in Mongo but do not affect any protected flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seeded users/products/customers verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py runs in ~5s and covers all critical paths. Frontend testIDs are comprehensive; use demo-{pemilik|kasir|gudang|driver}-button chips + login-submit-button to authenticate. For fresh logout in Playwright, use page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()") + page.reload() (auth token is stored client-side).
